newsitem.title: CHINA: New Asia to issue dividend, new shares.
newsitem.headline: New Asia to issue dividend, new shares.

text.p: Shareholders of Shanghai New Asia (Group) Co have approved a proposal by the firm's board of directors to issue a cash dividend, bonus and rights shares, a company statement said on Friday.
The shareholders at a meeting on Thursday approved a pre-tax dividend of 0.10 yuan per share based on 1996 net profit, the statement said.
The company reported a net profit of 102 million yuan for 1996, slightly down from 105.624 million yuan for 1995, based on international accounting standards.
The shareholders also agreed to a two-for-10 bonus share issue based on the firm's capital reserves, the statement said.
They empowered the board of directors to work out details for a three-for-10 rights issue at a price of between 3.0 and 5.0 yuan per share, the statement said.
The firm's foreign currency B shares closed at $0.58 on Thursday and its domestic A shares at 13.09 yuan.
Proceeds will be used to expand the company's major business of hotels and fast food shops, the statement said.
Details of the cash dividend and share issues will be announced later, the statement said.
